text:
Eva: Quick intake — bringing up pelican-11b (decoder) for hosted catalog. Need perf + quant plan.
Sam: Nice. What's SLO and priority?
Eva: SLO: p95 <= 120ms at batch=1 on A100-40GB for 512 tokens; throughput target ~800 t/s for batch=8 at 256 tokens. Priority: high for SearchPilot POC; timeline 2 weeks.
Ravi: I'll own perf runs. Suggest triage order: fp16 baseline -> int8 static (post-calib) -> int4 experimental.
Maya: Add quality gate: eval on 3 suites (conversational, instruction, search). Acceptance: delta-EM <= 2% vs fp16 and judged regressions <1.5%.
Eva: Checklist (working):
• create model entry in catalog (meta + model card)
• upload weights + config to storage
• compile kernels (GPU tuned)
• baseline fp16 smoke run
• int8 quant + calibration pass
• int4 quick smoke (if perf looks promising)
• ctx-length sweep: 64 / 128 / 256 / 512 / 1024
• batching sweep: batch = [1,2,4,8,16] and measure p50/p95/p99 + t/s
• kv-cache & warmup evaluation (cold vs warm)
• produce perf report + plots and attach traces
Sam: Can we reuse the automated bench script? Use: 
```
./run_bench.py --model pelican-11b --mode serve --cards a100 --bs 1 --tokens 512 --out perf/pelican/fp16
```
Ravi: Also include prefix warmup: `--warmup-prefix 128` and `--kvcache 1` to capture warmup overheads.
perf-bot: Scheduled bench job 4141592700 queued for pelican-11b fp16 baseline.
Nora: For int8 calibration, use representative calibration set of 5k sequences, seed=42. Capture per-layer min/max and histogram.
Maya: Quality eval command: `eval-suite --sets conv,inst,search --model fp16,int8,int4 --metrics bleu,rouge,exact_match` — keep raw outputs for human review.
Sam: Note: if int4 p95 > fp16 p95 * 1.25 abort int4 rollout and fallback to int8.
Ravi: I'll push a PR with bench config, calibration script, and perf dashboard links (perf.redwood/pelican).
Eva: Thanks — ping here when perf-bot posts results, we'll decide rollout to dedicated pool.
deploy-bot: Deployment window requested: 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC (approval required).
Sam: ack, hold until perf report.
perf-bot: Job 4141592700 completed. Baseline fp16: p95=108ms (batch=1); throughput batch=8 at 256 tokens = 820 t/s. int8: p95=115ms. int4: p95=162ms (regression flagged).
Maya: int4 regression >25% on p95; also search suite EM delta = -3.1% vs fp16 -> fail for int4.
Eva: Conclusion: onboard fp16 and int8 variants. Block int4 until we have per-layer quant tuning and calibration improvements.
Ravi: Next steps added to ticket RED-1287; scheduling 3-day int4 tuning spike.
Eva: ✅
